title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: A classic Italian pasta dish featuring spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, and a hint of spice.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 8-10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the pasta.

While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and chili flakes, sautéing until the garlic is golden, about 2-3 minutes. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with the garlic and chili oil. Toss to coat the pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to create a smooth sauce.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Chickpea Salad with Lemon Dressing
description: A refreshing Mediterranean salad featuring canned chickpeas, crisp cucumber, and a tangy lemon dressing, perfect for a light and healthy lunch.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas under cold water and set aside.
Dice the cucumber into small cubes and place in a large mixing bowl.
Juice the lemon and mince the garlic clove. Add the lemon juice, minced garlic, olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper to a small bowl. Whisk together to create the dressing.
Thinly slice the red onion if using, and chop the parsley.
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, red onion, and parsley in the mixing bowl. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat evenly.
Let the salad sit for at least 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld before serving.

title: Beef Tacos with Salsa
description: These flavorful beef tacos are paired with a fresh and spicy salsa, perfect for a Mexican-themed dinner night.

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the ground beef to the skillet. Cook and stir until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in cumin, cayenne pepper, sea salt, black pepper, minced garlic, and taco spice mix. Cook for an additional 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Warm the tortillas in a separate pan or in the oven for a few minutes.
Dice the tomatoes and red onion. Finely chop the jalapeno and cilantro. In a bowl, combine these with lime juice to create the salsa.
Assemble the tacos by placing the beef mixture into each tortilla, then top with salsa. Optionally, add sliced avocado.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired vegetable stir-fry perfect for a weeknight dinner.

steps.instruction: Prepare the ingredients by mincing the ginger and garlic. Cut the green onions into thin slices. Cube the tofu if using.
Heat olive oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add minced ginger and garlic to the pan and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until they start to soften. If using tofu, add it now and cook until slightly golden.
Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, and stir well to coat the vegetables evenly. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with black pepper to taste. Add green onions and sesame seeds if using, and toss everything to combine.
Serve the stir-fry hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.

title: Classic Pancakes
description: Fluffy and light pancakes perfect for a classic American breakfast.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In another bowl, beat the egg and then mix in the milk and melted butter. Add the vanilla extract if using.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix; some lumps are okay.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and lightly coat with vegetable oil.
For each pancake, pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2-3 minutes. Flip and cook the other side until golden brown, about 2 minutes more.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more oil to the skillet as necessary.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
description: A nutritious and flavorful Mediterranean-inspired quinoa bowl featuring fresh vegetables, feta cheese, and a lemon-olive oil dressing.

steps.instruction: Rinse the quinoa under cold water using a fine mesh strainer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed quinoa and water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the quinoa is tender and water is absorbed.
While the quinoa is cooking, halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, and slice the red onion thinly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Once the quinoa is cooked, fluff it with a fork and let it cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, kalamata olives, feta cheese, red onion, and spinach.
Pour the dressing over the quinoa mixture and toss gently to combine.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if using, and serve immediately.

title: Butter Chicken Curry
description: A rich and creamy Indian butter chicken curry made with tender chicken pieces simmered in a spiced tomato sauce with a touch of cream.

steps.instruction: Cut the chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the pan and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder, black pepper, and sea salt. Cook for 2 minutes to toast the spices.
Add canned tomatoes and coconut milk to the pan. Stir to combine, then cover and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in butter and lemon juice. Let it simmer uncovered for an additional 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Classic American chocolate chip cookies with a crisp edge and chewy center.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, baking soda, and sea salt. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the unsalted butter, sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the vanilla extract and eggs to the butter mixture, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually blend in the dry ingredients until just combined.
Stir in the chocolate chips and walnuts (if using) until evenly distributed.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: A classic Thai noodle dish featuring shrimp, rice noodles, and a tangy sauce, garnished with peanuts and lime.

steps.instruction: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes or until softened. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice. Set aside the sauce mixture.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until they turn pink. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, crack the eggs and scramble until cooked through. Push to one side of the pan.
Add the drained rice noodles and the sauce mixture to the pan. Toss everything together and cook for 3-4 minutes until the noodles are heated through.
Return the shrimp to the pan along with sliced green onions and bean sprouts. Toss to combine and heat through for 2 minutes.
Transfer the Pad Thai to serving plates. Garnish with chopped peanuts, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges if desired.

title: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Peppers
description: A delightful Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring bell peppers stuffed with spinach, feta cheese, and aromatic herbs, perfect for a satisfying dinner.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked spinach, crumbled feta cheese, cooked quinoa, dried oregano, black pepper, and sea salt. Mix well.
Stuff each bell pepper with the spinach and feta mixture. Place the stuffed peppers in a baking dish and drizzle with the remaining tablespoon of olive oil.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the peppers are tender.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes to slightly brown the tops.
Serve the stuffed peppers warm, with a side of your choice.

title: Homemade Hummus with Pita
description: Creamy homemade hummus paired with warm, soft pita bread for a delicious Middle Eastern snack.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the chickpeas thoroughly under cold water.
In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, sea salt, and cumin.
Blend the mixture until smooth, adding 2-3 tbsp of water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more lemon juice or salt to taste.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and drizzle with a bit of olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Warm the pita bread slightly in an oven or toaster for about 5 minutes at 350°F (175°C).
Cut the warm pita into triangles and serve alongside the hummus.

title: Egg Fried Rice
description: A classic Chinese dish featuring stir-fried rice with eggs and vegetables, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil, perfect for a quick and satisfying dinner.

steps.instruction: Cook the rice according to package instructions and let it cool. Ideally, use day-old rice for better texture.
Dice the carrot and chop the green onions. Mince the garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and diced carrots. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until the carrots start to soften.
Add the green peas to the pan and continue to stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan and pour the beaten eggs into the other side. Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then mix them with the vegetables.
Add the cooked rice to the pan, breaking up any clumps. Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil over the rice and mix everything well.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Add chopped green onions and stir well. Cook for another 2 minutes until everything is heated through.

title: Caprese Salad with Balsamic Glaze
description: A classic Italian salad featuring fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, and fragrant basil, drizzled with a sweet and tangy balsamic glaze.

steps.instruction: Slice the ripe tomatoes into 0.5 cm thick rounds.
Slice the fresh mozzarella into 0.5 cm thick rounds.
Layer the tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a serving platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the tomato and mozzarella slices.
Drizzle olive oil evenly over the salad.
Drizzle balsamic glaze evenly over the salad.
Season the salad with sea salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Lentil Soup
description: A hearty and comforting lentil soup, perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Dice the onion, carrots, and celery. Mince the garlic.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots, and celery. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, dried thyme, and curry powder to the pot. Stir and cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the canned tomatoes, lentils, vegetable broth, sea salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover. Simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach and cook for an additional 5 minutes until the spinach is wilted.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice for brightness, if using. Adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.

title: Coconut Curry Chickpeas
description: A fragrant and creamy Indian-inspired dish featuring chickpeas simmered in a rich coconut curry sauce.

steps.instruction: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves. Grate or finely chop the ginger.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the curry powder and cumin to the pan, stirring to coat the onions, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas. Add them to the pan, stirring to combine with the sauce.
Let the curry simmer for about 15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
If using, add the spinach and let it wilt into the curry, about 2 minutes.
Season with sea salt and black pepper. Stir in lime juice if using.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

title: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Italian Margherita Pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and tomato sauce, served on a crisp crust.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 475°F (245°C) and place a pizza stone or baking sheet inside to heat.
Roll out the pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to your desired thickness.
Transfer the rolled-out dough to a piece of parchment paper, which makes it easier to transfer to the oven.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border around the edges.
Tear the fresh mozzarella into pieces and distribute evenly over the tomato sauce.
Tear the basil leaves and scatter them over the mozzarella.
Drizzle olive oil over the top and sprinkle with sea salt and optional black pepper.
Carefully slide the pizza with parchment paper onto the preheated pizza stone or baking sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly before slicing and serving.

title: Banana Bread
description: A classic American dessert, this banana bread is moist, flavorful, and perfect for any occasion. It's a delightful way to use up ripe bananas, offering a rich taste with a hint of cinnamon.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan or line it with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking soda, sea salt, and cinnamon (if using). Set aside.
In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. This should take about 2-3 minutes.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Mash the bananas in a separate bowl, then add them to the butter mixture. Stir in the sour cream until well combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing just until combined. If using, fold in the walnuts.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake in the preheated oven for 55-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then, transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Falafel Wraps with Tahini Sauce
description: Delicious Middle Eastern falafel wraps paired with a creamy tahini sauce, perfect for a satisfying lunch.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Place them in a food processor.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, parsley, cilantro, flour, baking powder, sea salt, and black pepper to the food processor. Pulse until a coarse mixture forms.
Form the mixture into small balls or patties using your hands.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry the falafel balls or patties until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
To make the tahini sauce, whisk together tahini, lemon juice, water, and a pinch of sea salt in a small bowl until smooth.
Slice cucumber and tomato into thin slices.
Warm the pita bread in a dry skillet or the oven for 1-2 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few falafel balls or patties on each pita. Top with cucumber, tomato, and a generous drizzle of tahini sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Succulent shrimp sautéed in garlic butter with a hint of lemon and herbs, perfect for a quick and flavorful Mediterranean dinner.

steps.instruction: Peel and devein the shrimp, if necessary, and pat them dry with paper towels.
Mince the garlic cloves and chop the parsley finely. Zest the lemon and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Add the shrimp to the skillet in a single layer. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until they turn pink and opaque.
Reduce the heat to low and add butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine, allowing the butter to melt completely.
Remove the skillet from heat and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the shrimp. Toss gently to coat.
Serve the garlic butter shrimp immediately, garnished with extra lemon wedges if desired.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: A creamy and savory Italian risotto featuring earthy mushrooms and aromatic herbs, perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Slice the mushrooms thinly.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add chopped onion and garlic, sauté until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release moisture and brown slightly, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the arborio rice, cooking for 1-2 minutes until the rice is lightly toasted.
Pour in the white wine, if using, and cook until absorbed by the rice.

Gradually add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring frequently. Allow the rice to absorb most of the liquid before adding more. Continue this process until the rice is creamy and cooked to al dente, about 18-20 minutes.
Stir in the butter and parmesan cheese until melted and well combined. Season with black pepper and sea salt to taste.
Remove from heat and let sit for a minute. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
description: Delicious zucchini boats stuffed with a flavorful mixture of quinoa, chickpeas, and spices, perfect for a healthy dinner.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the zucchinis in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Reserve the flesh for later use.
Brush the zucchini shells with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and place them in a baking dish.
Chop the reserved zucchini flesh finely.
In a pan, heat the remaining olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped zucchini flesh and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Add them to the pan along with quinoa, cumin, coriander, sea salt, and black pepper. Mix well and cook for another 2 minutes.
Remove the mixture from heat and stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Fill each zucchini shell with the prepared mixture and sprinkle feta cheese on top if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes until the zucchinis are tender and the tops are golden brown.
Let the stuffed zucchini boats cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Fruit Smoothie Bowl
description: A refreshing and nutritious fruit smoothie bowl topped with a variety of delicious and healthy ingredients, perfect for a vibrant start to your day.

steps.instruction: Place the frozen bananas, frozen berries, and soy milk in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy. If the mixture is too thick, add a little more soy milk to reach your desired consistency.
Pour the smoothie mixture into two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, chia seeds, coconut flakes, and sliced fresh strawberries.
Drizzle with honey for added sweetness, if desired.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Skewers
description: Juicy grilled chicken skewers marinated in a flavorful teriyaki sauce, perfect for a quick and delicious Japanese-inspired dinner.

steps.instruction: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent them from burning during grilling.
Cut the chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a bowl, mix soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil to create the marinade.
Add chicken cubes to the marinade, making sure each piece is well coated. Marinate for at least 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
Preheat the grill or grill pan over medium-high heat and brush with olive oil.
Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto the soaked skewers, distributing evenly.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes on each side, until the chicken is cooked through and has grill marks.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Energy Balls
description: These Peanut Butter Energy Balls are a quick and easy snack, perfect for a boost of energy during the day. Packed with the goodness of oats, peanut butter, and a touch of sweetness, they are both nutritious and delicious.

steps.instruction: In a large mixing bowl, combine the peanut butter, oats, and honey. Mix well until all the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
If using, add the chia seeds, cacao nibs, and vanilla extract to the mixture. Stir until evenly distributed.
Take approximately one tablespoon of the mixture and roll it into a ball using your hands. Repeat the process until all the mixture is used up, forming about 12 balls.
Place the energy balls on a plate or tray. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow them to firm up before serving.

title: Vegetarian Chili
description: A hearty and comforting vegetarian chili that's perfect for dinner. This dish is packed with beans, tomatoes, and spices, providing a delicious and satisfying meal.

steps.instruction: Dice the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Chop the bell peppers and carrots into small pieces.
Add the chopped bell peppers and carrots to the pot. Cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, coriander, black pepper, and sea salt. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, canned beans, and vegetable broth. Stir well to combine.
Bring the chili to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and let it cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: A flavorful Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring grilled chicken marinated in lemon and herbs, perfect for a light and healthy dinner.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, mix lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, sea salt, black pepper, and lemon zest to create the marinade.
Place the chicken breasts in the marinade, ensuring they are fully coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to infuse.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove chicken from the marinade and place on the grill. Cook each side for about 5-7 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and has a nice char.
Remove from grill and let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Baked Ziti with Spinach and Ricotta
description: A comforting Italian-American classic, this Baked Ziti with Spinach and Ricotta is perfect for family dinners. Creamy ricotta, hearty marinara sauce, and nutritious spinach make this dish both delicious and satisfying.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook the ziti pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside.
While the pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese, half of the mozzarella cheese, half of the Parmesan cheese, cooked spinach, black pepper, and sea salt. Mix well.
Add the cooked ziti and marinara sauce to the ricotta mixture. Stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the pasta mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes. Garnish with fresh basil if desired before serving.

title: Savory Sweet Potato Hash
description: A hearty and flavorful breakfast hash featuring sweet potatoes, bell peppers, and onions. Perfect for a cozy brunch or a quick breakfast.

steps.instruction: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into small cubes. Ensure they are roughly the same size for even cooking.
Dice the red bell pepper, green bell pepper (if using), and onion into small pieces.
Mince the garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and sauté for about 3 minutes until they begin to soften.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced sweet potatoes to the skillet. Stir to coat with oil. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced bell peppers, cumin, black pepper, and sea salt to the skillet. Stir well.
Cook uncovered for another 5 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and the peppers are softened.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving, if desired.

title: Spicy Thai Basil Tofu
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired vegan dish featuring tofu stir-fried with fresh basil leaves and a spicy soy sauce blend. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

steps.instruction: Drain the tofu and press it to remove excess moisture. Cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
While the tofu is cooking, mince the garlic and slice the red chili.
Add the garlic and red chili to the pan with the tofu. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, maple syrup, and lime juice. Pour over the tofu and stir to coat evenly.
Add the basil leaves to the pan and stir until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Season with black pepper and sea salt to taste. Serve hot over cooked jasmine rice if desired.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
description: A healthy and flavorful Indian-inspired curry featuring chickpeas, spinach, and coconut milk, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Chop the onion and add it to the pan. Sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Mince the garlic and ginger. Add them to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add curry powder and cumin to the pan, stirring to coat the onions evenly.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, including their juice, and stir to combine.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Add them to the pan along with the coconut milk. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Reduce heat and let it cook for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Add the spinach to the curry, stirring until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season with sea salt and black pepper. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Finish with a splash of lime juice and garnish with cilantro if using. Serve hot with rice or bread.

title: Caprese Pasta Salad
description: A refreshing Italian pasta salad featuring classic Caprese flavors with mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil.

steps.instruction: Cook the fusilli pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
While the pasta cooks, halve the cherry tomatoes and cut the mozzarella cheese into small cubes.
Chop the fresh basil leaves roughly.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled fusilli pasta, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella cubes, and chopped basil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, sea salt, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing over the pasta salad and toss gently to combine all ingredients.
Let the salad sit for at least 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld before serving.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa
description: A delicious and healthy Mediterranean-inspired dinner featuring bell peppers stuffed with quinoa, black beans, and a medley of vegetables and spices. Perfect for a vegetarian meal prep option!

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.

Rinse the quinoa under cold water. In a pot, combine 1 cup of quinoa with 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy.
While the quinoa is cooking, heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Chop the onion and mince the garlic, then sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin and coriander to the pan, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain and rinse the black beans. Add them to the pan with the cooked quinoa, tomato sauce, sea salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Stuff each bell pepper with the quinoa mixture, pressing down lightly to pack the filling.
Place stuffed peppers in a baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes until peppers are tender.
Optional: Top the stuffed peppers with crumbled feta cheese before serving.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.

title: Peach Cobbler
description: A classic American dessert featuring juicy peaches and a sweet, buttery crust.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Peel and slice the peaches into thin wedges, removing the pits.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sliced peaches with 1/2 cup of sugar, 1 tsp of cinnamon, and 1 tbsp of lemon juice. Stir well and set aside.
In another bowl, mix together 1 cup of flour, 1 tbsp of baking powder, 1/2 tsp of baking soda, 1/4 tsp of sea salt, and the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar.
Melt 1/2 cup of butter in a saucepan over low heat or in the microwave.
Add the melted butter, 1 tsp of vanilla extract, and 3/4 cup of milk to the dry ingredients. Stir until just combined to create a batter.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish and spread evenly.
Spoon the peach mixture evenly over the batter. Do not stir.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the peaches are bubbling.
Allow the cobbler to cool slightly before serving. Enjoy warm, optionally with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Cilantro Lime Rice
description: A zesty and fresh Mexican-inspired side dish, perfect to accompany any main course. This easy-to-make rice is infused with the vibrant flavors of cilantro and lime, making it a refreshing addition to your dinner table.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear to remove excess starch.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the rinsed rice and sea salt.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, chop the cilantro finely and zest the lime.
Once the rice is cooked, remove it from the heat and let it sit covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork, then stir in the lime juice, olive oil, lime zest, and chopped cilantro.
Serve warm as a side dish with your favorite Mexican main course.

title: Korean BBQ Beef Bowls
description: Savory Korean BBQ beef bowls featuring marinated beef, fresh vegetables, and rice, perfect for a flavorful dinner.

steps.instruction: Slice the beef into thin strips and set aside.
In a bowl, mix soy sauce (ensure it's gluten-free), brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sesame oil to create the marinade.
Marinate the beef strips in the soy sauce mixture for at least 15 minutes.
While the beef marinates, rinse and cook the rice according to package instructions.
Slice the green onions finely, grate the carrots, and slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and cook the marinated beef for about 5 minutes or until fully cooked, stirring frequently.
Assemble the bowls by placing cooked rice at the bottom. Top with cooked beef, sliced cucumbers, grated carrots, and green onions.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and red pepper flakes over the top for garnish.

title: Vegetable Samosas
description: Crispy Indian pastry filled with spiced vegetables, perfect for a snack or appetizer.

steps.instruction: Peel and dice the potatoes and carrot. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Grate the ginger.
In a pot, boil the potatoes and carrots for 10 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside.
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat. Add onions, garlic, and ginger, sauté until onions are translucent.
Add cumin, curry powder, coriander, cayenne pepper, and sea-salt. Stir for 2 minutes to release flavors.
Add boiled potatoes, carrots, and peas to the pan. Pour in 0.25 cup water. Mash slightly and cook for 5 minutes. Allow filling to cool.
In a bowl, mix flour with a pinch of salt. Add 2 tbsp olive oil and gradually add water to form a dough. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 12 equal balls. Roll each into a circle and cut in half to form semi-circles.
Shape each semi-circle into a cone, fill with vegetable mixture, and seal edges with water.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan. Fry samosas in batches until golden brown, about 5 minutes per batch.
Drain samosas on paper towels to remove excess oil. Serve hot.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
description: A light and refreshing Italian-inspired dish featuring zucchini noodles tossed in a flavorful pesto sauce, perfect for a quick dinner.

steps.instruction: Using a spiralizer, create zucchini noodles from the 2 zucchinis.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the zucchini noodles to the pan and sauté for 3-4 minutes until they are slightly tender.
Add 0.5 cup of pesto-sauce to the pan, stirring gently to coat the noodles evenly.
If using, halve the cherry tomatoes and add them to the pan, cooking for an additional 1 minute until they're warm.
Season with 0.5 tsp of sea-salt and 0.25 tsp of black-pepper to taste.
Serve the zucchini noodles topped with 0.25 cup of grated parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Shrimp and Avocado Salad
description: A refreshing Mediterranean-inspired shrimp and avocado salad, perfect for a light lunch.

steps.instruction: Peel and devein the shrimp, if necessary.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until pink and opaque.
While the shrimp are cooking, halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the avocado, and slice the cucumber and red onion thinly.
In a large bowl, combine cherry tomatoes, avocado, cucumber, red onion, and cooked shrimp.
In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
If using, crumble feta cheese over the salad and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
description: A rich and creamy vegan dessert made with ripe avocados and cocoa powder, sweetened with maple syrup for a luxurious treat.

steps.instruction: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a blender or food processor.
Add the cacao powder, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and sea salt to the blender.
Blend the ingredients on high speed until smooth and creamy. Scrape down the sides as needed.
If the mixture is too thick, add coconut milk gradually until the desired consistency is reached.
Divide the mousse into individual serving glasses or bowls.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to enhance the flavors.

title: Homemade Pizza with Fresh Toppings
description: A classic Italian-style pizza with a homemade crust, topped with a variety of fresh vegetables and herbs.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out the pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to your desired thickness.
Transfer the rolled-out dough onto a pizza stone or baking sheet.
Brush the dough lightly with olive oil to create a crispier crust.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the surface of the dough.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese evenly over the tomato sauce.
Add sliced red onion, chopped peppers, sliced mushrooms, and olives as desired.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove the pizza from the oven and sprinkle fresh basil over the top before serving.

title: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Moroccan-inspired stew with chickpeas and aromatic spices, perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Dice the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, ground ginger, and cayenne pepper. Stir and cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the canned tomatoes with their juice, chickpeas, and vegetable broth to the pot. Stir well to combine.
Peel and slice the carrots. Slice the zucchini. Add both to the pot.
Season with sea salt, black pepper, and coriander. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in lemon juice and chopped cilantro before serving, if desired.

title: Butternut Squash Risotto
description: A creamy and comforting Italian risotto made with sweet butternut squash, perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Peel the butternut squash, remove the seeds, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
Finely chop the onion and garlic.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the butternut squash cubes and cook for 5-7 minutes until they begin to soften.
Add the chopped onion and garlic to the pan, and sauté for an additional 5 minutes until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until the rice is lightly toasted.

Gradually add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring frequently. Allow the liquid to be absorbed before adding more broth. Repeat until all broth is used and the rice is creamy and cooked through, about 18-20 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan cheese and butter, if using, and season with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh sage before serving, if desired.

title: Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal
description: A warm and healthy breakfast option that combines the comforting flavors of cinnamon and apples with hearty oats.

steps.instruction: Peel, core, and dice the honeycrisp apple into small pieces.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Stir in 1 cup of oats and a pinch of sea salt (optional). Reduce heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced apple and 1 tsp of cinnamon to the oats. Stir to combine, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the apples are tender.
Remove from heat and stir in 0.5 tsp of vanilla extract (optional) and 1 tbsp of maple syrup (optional) for sweetness.
Serve the oatmeal into bowls and top with 2 tbsp of chopped walnuts (optional) for added texture and flavor.

title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
description: Spicy and flavorful Jamaican Jerk Chicken, marinated with a blend of Caribbean spices and herbs, then grilled to perfection.

steps.instruction: Prepare the marinade by combining olive oil, soy sauce, lime juice, cayenne pepper, allspice, cinnamon, nutmeg, thyme, black pepper, and sea salt in a bowl.
Finely chop the scallions and add to the marinade.
Mince the garlic cloves and grate the ginger, then add both to the marinade.
Place the chicken thighs in a large resealable bag or bowl and pour the marinade over them. Ensure the chicken is well coated.
Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or overnight for best results.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 6-8 minutes on each side, or until fully cooked and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving. Serve with your choice of sides such as rice and peas or fried plantains.

title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
description: A classic American lunch option, these egg salad sandwiches offer a creamy and flavorful experience perfect for any midday meal.

steps.instruction: Place the eggs in a pot and cover them with water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Once boiling, remove the pot from heat and cover with a lid. Let the eggs sit for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water to cool for 5 minutes.
Peel the cooled eggs and chop them into small pieces.
In a mixing bowl, combine chopped eggs, mayonnaise, mustard, chopped green onions, chopped celery, sea salt, and black pepper. Mix well until all ingredients are evenly incorporated.
Toast the sourdough bread slices if desired.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading the egg salad mixture evenly over four slices of bread. Top with lettuce leaves if using, and cover with the remaining slices of bread.

title: Honey Garlic Roasted Carrots
description: These Honey Garlic Roasted Carrots are a simple, sweet, and savory side dish perfect for any dinner. The natural sweetness of the carrots is enhanced by honey and balanced by the savory notes of garlic.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Peel the carrots and cut them into evenly sized sticks, about 3 inches long.
Mince the garlic cloves finely.
In a large bowl, combine the olive oil, honey, minced garlic, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the carrot sticks to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated with the honey garlic mixture.
Spread the coated carrots onto a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast the carrots in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and slightly caramelized, flipping them halfway through.
Optional: Garnish with chopped parsley before serving for a fresh touch.

title: Coconut Macaroons
description: Deliciously chewy coconut macaroons with a hint of vanilla, perfect for a sweet treat.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 325°F (165°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the coconut flakes, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla extract. Mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites with a pinch of sea salt until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the coconut mixture until fully incorporated.
Using a tablespoon, scoop the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 1 inch apart.
Bake in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until the macaroons are golden brown.
Remove from oven and allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Red Lentil Dal
description: A warm, comforting, and healthy Indian dish made with red lentils, aromatic spices, and creamy coconut milk. Perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Rinse the red lentils under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain and set aside.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, and curry powder to the pot. Stir and cook for another minute to toast the spices.
Add the canned tomatoes with their juice, and bring to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the red lentils, coconut milk, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
If using, add the spinach and cook for an additional 3-5 minutes until wilted.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Adjust seasoning if necessary.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.

title: Balsamic Glazed Brussels Sprouts
description: A savory and slightly sweet dish of roasted Brussels sprouts, perfectly glazed with balsamic vinegar and garlic.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C).
Trim the ends of the Brussels sprouts and slice them in half.
Peel and mince the garlic cloves.
In a large bowl, toss the Brussels sprouts with olive oil, minced garlic, sea salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the Brussels sprouts on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast the Brussels sprouts in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, turning halfway through, until they are tender and slightly crispy on the edges.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Toss to coat evenly.
Serve immediately as a side dish or a main course.

title: Lemon Garlic Roasted Chicken
description: A flavorful Mediterranean-inspired dish perfect for dinner, featuring chicken roasted with fresh lemon and garlic.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Pat the whole chicken dry with paper towels and place it in a roasting pan.
In a small bowl, mix the olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, minced garlic, and rosemary (if using).
Rub the mixture all over the chicken, ensuring it is evenly coated. Season with sea salt and black pepper.
Place the chicken in the oven and roast for about 60 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C) and the juices run clear.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for at least 10 minutes before carving.

title: Quinoa and Black Bean Stuffed Avocados
description: A delightful and nutritious Mexican-inspired dish featuring creamy avocados stuffed with a flavorful mix of quinoa, black beans, and vegetables. Perfect for a light and satisfying lunch.

steps.instruction: Rinse the quinoa under cold water.
In a small pot, combine 0.5 cup of quinoa with 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
While the quinoa is cooking, halve the avocados and remove the pits. Scoop out a small portion of the flesh to create room for stuffing.
Dice the scooped avocado flesh and place it in a bowl. Add black beans, cherry tomatoes, diced red onion, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, sea salt, black pepper, and olive oil (if using). Pour this dressing over the avocado mixture and mix well.
Once the quinoa is cooked, fluff it with a fork and let it cool slightly.
Combine the cooked quinoa with the avocado mixture, stirring gently to combine.
Stuff the avocado halves with the quinoa and black bean mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato and Kale Frittata
description: A delicious and healthy Italian-inspired frittata featuring sweet potatoes and kale, perfect for a nutritious brunch.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into small cubes.
Wash and chop the kale, removing any tough stems.
Chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
In a large oven-proof skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced sweet potatoes to the skillet and sauté for about 10 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet, and cook for an additional 3 minutes until onion is translucent.
Stir in the chopped kale, cooking until it wilts, about 3 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, sea salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet. Sprinkle with feta cheese if using.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove from oven, let it cool slightly, then slice and serve warm.

title: Pesto Zoodles with Cherry Tomatoes
description: A light and fresh Italian-inspired dish featuring zucchini noodles tossed with vibrant pesto sauce and juicy cherry tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Using a spiralizer, create zucchini noodles from the whole zucchinis. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Mince the garlic clove and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the pan and cook until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the zucchini noodles to the pan and toss with the tomatoes and garlic. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the zoodles are slightly tender.
Remove the pan from heat and stir in the pesto sauce, ensuring the zoodles are thoroughly coated.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Transfer to serving plates and garnish with parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Cajun Shrimp Tacos with Avocado Crema
description: Spicy Cajun shrimp tacos paired with a creamy avocado crema, perfect for a flavorful and easy dinner.

steps.instruction: Peel and devein the shrimp if necessary. Pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine shrimp, olive oil, and Cajun seasoning. Toss to coat evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until fully cooked.
Meanwhile, prepare the avocado crema. In a blender, combine avocados, lime juice, sour cream, chopped cilantro, sea salt, black pepper, and minced garlic. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing a spoonful of avocado crema on the bottom of each taco shell. Add cooked shrimp, top with shredded red cabbage, and sliced jalapenos if desired.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges or cilantro for garnish if desired.

title: Pineapple Fried Rice
description: A delicious and vibrant Thai-inspired dish featuring savory fried rice with sweet pineapple chunks, vegetables, and cashews, perfect for a tropical lunch.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the fresh garlic and ginger, and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced carrot and sauté for another 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add the green peas and canned bell peppers to the pan, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the empty side.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the vegetables.
Pour the soy sauce over the rice mixture, add black pepper and sea salt, and toss well to combine evenly.
Fold in the pineapple chunks and roasted cashews, and cook for 2 more minutes until everything is heated through.
Remove from heat and garnish with chopped green onions before serving.

title: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Buddha Bowl
description: A nourishing and vibrant Mediterranean-inspired Buddha bowl featuring roasted chickpeas and sweet potatoes, served with fresh greens and a tangy tahini dressing.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C).
Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Place the chickpeas and sweet potatoes on a baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tbsp of olive oil, and sprinkle with 0.5 tsp sea salt and 0.25 tsp black pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Roast the chickpeas and sweet potatoes in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and chickpeas are crisp.
While the chickpeas and sweet potatoes are roasting, prepare the vegetables. Thinly slice the cucumber and red onion. Set aside.
Make the tahini dressing by combining 2 tbsp tahini, juice of 0.5 lemon, 2 tbsp water, and 1 minced garlic clove in a small bowl. Whisk until smooth. Adjust consistency with more water if needed.
To assemble the Buddha bowl, divide the spinach between two bowls. Top with roasted chickpeas, sweet potatoes, cucumber slices, and red onion. Drizzle with tahini dressing.

title: Garlic Butter Lobster Pasta
description: A luxurious Italian-inspired dish featuring succulent lobster tails in a rich garlic butter sauce, served over perfectly cooked pasta.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water, drain the pasta, and set aside.
While the pasta is cooking, prepare the lobster tails. Using kitchen shears, cut the top shell down the center to expose the meat. Gently pull the meat out while keeping it attached at the tail end.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lobster tails to the skillet, meat side down. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until the shell is bright red and the meat is opaque.
Remove the lobster tails from the skillet. Let them cool slightly, then remove the meat from the shells and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add butter, and let it melt. Stir in lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper. Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet.
Add the cooked pasta and lobster meat to the skillet. Toss everything together until the pasta is well coated with the garlic butter sauce.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped parsley. Serve immediately, garnished with grated parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Spicy Lentil and Tomato Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Indian-inspired stew made with red lentils, tomatoes, and a blend of spices. Perfect for a warming dinner.

steps.instruction: Rinse the red lentils under cold water until the water runs clear. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Dice the onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Mince the garlic and ginger. Add them to the pot and sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin, cooking for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add the canned tomatoes (including juice) and coconut milk to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the rinsed lentils and water. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. If using, stir in chopped cilantro and lime juice before serving.

title: Caprese Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
description: A delightful Italian-inspired dish featuring portobello mushrooms stuffed with fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, and fragrant basil. Perfect as an impressive dinner party appetizer or a light main course.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
Clean the portobello mushrooms by gently wiping them with a damp cloth to remove any dirt. Remove the stems and gills with a spoon.
Brush the mushroom caps with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet, gill side up.
Slice the fresh mozzarella and tomatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Place slices of mozzarella and tomato into each mushroom cap, alternating them. Sprinkle with sea salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and the mushrooms are tender.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with balsamic glaze. Garnish with fresh basil leaves.
Serve warm and enjoy your Caprese Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms.

title: Zaatar Roasted Cauliflower
description: A flavorful and healthy Middle Eastern snack featuring roasted cauliflower with a zesty zaatar seasoning.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets and place them in a large mixing bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cauliflower florets and toss to coat evenly.
Add the zaatar, sea salt, and black pepper to the cauliflower and mix until well combined and the florets are evenly coated with spices.
Spread the seasoned cauliflower florets in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the cauliflower in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and golden brown, stirring halfway through cooking.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Vegan Chocolate Chia Pudding
description: A creamy and delicious vegan dessert that combines the rich flavor of cocoa with the nutritional benefits of chia seeds and coconut milk. Perfect for a healthy dessert option.

steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine the chia seeds, coconut milk, cacao powder, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and a pinch of sea salt.
Whisk the ingredients together until well combined and the cacao powder is fully incorporated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to allow the chia seeds to absorb the liquid and form a pudding-like consistency.
Before serving, stir the pudding to ensure even consistency.
Serve the pudding in individual bowls or glasses and top with fresh berries if desired.

title: Savory Oatmeal with Spinach and Poached Egg
description: A healthy and hearty breakfast option featuring savory oatmeal topped with fresh spinach and a perfectly poached egg.

steps.instruction: Mince the garlic clove finely.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the oats and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are tender.
In a skillet over medium heat, add 1 tbsp of olive oil. Sauté the minced garlic for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes. Season with 0.5 tsp of sea salt and 0.25 tsp of black pepper. Set aside.
Meanwhile, poach the eggs in simmering water until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 3-4 minutes.
Divide the cooked oats into two bowls. Top each with sautéed spinach and a poached egg.
If using, sprinkle 0.25 cup of crumbled feta cheese over the top before serving.

title: Honey Soy Glazed Salmon
description: A delectable Japanese-inspired dinner featuring salmon glazed with a sweet and savory honey soy sauce, perfect for a quick yet elegant meal.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a small bowl, mix together 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp grated ginger to create the glaze.
Place the salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the glaze generously over each fillet.
Drizzle 2 tbsp of olive oil over the salmon and bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Optional: Sprinkle 1 tbsp sesame seeds and chopped green onion over the salmon before serving for added flavor and garnish.

title: Roasted Vegetable Quinoa Salad
description: A hearty and healthy Mediterranean-inspired salad featuring roasted vegetables and quinoa, perfect for a satisfying lunch.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rinse 1 cup of quinoa under cold water using a fine mesh strainer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed quinoa with 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
While the quinoa is cooking, chop the red bell pepper, zucchini, and carrots into bite-sized pieces. Cut the broccoli into small florets.
Place the chopped vegetables and 1 cup of cherry tomatoes on a baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tbsp of olive oil, and sprinkle with 1 tsp of sea salt and 0.5 tsp of black pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized, stirring halfway through.
Once the quinoa is cooked, remove from heat and let it sit, covered, for 5 minutes. Then, fluff with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, and 0.25 cup of chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle the salad with 1 tbsp of olive oil and 2 tbsp of lemon juice. Toss everything together until well combined.
Serve the salad warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!

title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
description: A spicy, tangy snack perfect for parties or as a game-day appetizer.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
In a large bowl, mix olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, sea salt, and black pepper. Add the cauliflower florets and toss until evenly coated.
Spread the cauliflower florets on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in the hot sauce until well combined. Remove from heat.
Once the cauliflower is done baking, remove from the oven and drizzle the hot sauce mixture over the florets. Toss to coat evenly.
Return the cauliflower to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes until the sauce is slightly absorbed and the florets are crispy.
Serve hot with optional blue cheese dressing on the side.

title: Turmeric Coconut Rice
description: A fragrant and creamy rice dish infused with the warm flavors of turmeric and coconut, perfect as a comforting side or main dish.

steps.instruction: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain well.
In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan, stirring to coat the grains in the oil, garlic, and ginger mixture.
Stir in the coconut milk, water, turmeric, sea salt, and cinnamon (if using). Bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove from heat and let the rice sit covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving.
Garnish with black pepper and chopped cilantro before serving, if desired.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
description: A classic Italian dish, Baked Eggplant Parmesan is a hearty and flavorful meal made with layers of breaded eggplant, rich tomato sauce, and melted cheese.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Slice the eggplants into 1/4-inch thick rounds and sprinkle with sea salt. Let them sit for 10 minutes to draw out moisture.
Meanwhile, mince the garlic cloves.
In a shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup of parmesan cheese, dried oregano, and black pepper.
In another shallow dish, beat the eggs.
Place the flour in a third shallow dish.
Pat the eggplant slices dry with paper towels. Dredge each slice in flour, dip in egg, and coat with the breadcrumb mixture.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry the eggplant slices until golden brown on each side, about 3 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels.

In a baking dish, spread a layer of tomato sauce. Place a layer of fried eggplant slices on top, sprinkle with minced garlic, some mozzarella, and parmesan cheese. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden.

title: Chili Lime Roasted Chickpeas
description: A crunchy and tangy snack perfect for satisfying your mid-day cravings. These roasted chickpeas are infused with the zesty flavors of lime and the heat of chili, making them a delightful treat.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas thoroughly. Pat them dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture.
In a large bowl, mix the olive oil, lime juice, chili oil (if using), cumin, cayenne pepper, and sea salt.
Add the dried chickpeas to the bowl and toss them until evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Spread the chickpeas on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway through, until the chickpeas are golden and crispy.
Remove from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes. Sprinkle with lime zest before serving.

title: Peach and Berry Crumble
description: A delightful dessert featuring juicy peaches and a mix of berries topped with a sweet, crunchy crumble.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Slice the peaches into thin wedges and place them in a large mixing bowl.
Add the frozen berries and lemon juice to the peaches. Toss gently to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix together oats, flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and sea salt.
Cut the butter into small pieces and add to the oat mixture. Use your fingers to incorporate the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Spread the peach and berry mixture evenly in a baking dish. Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the fruit.
Bake in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Allow the crumble to cool slightly before serving.

title: Vegetable Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian rice dish made with a mix of vegetables and spices, perfect for a family dinner.

steps.instruction: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Soak the rice in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add chopped onion and sauté until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot. Sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, curry powder, and cinnamon stick. Cook for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add mixed vegetables and sauté for 5 minutes until they begin to soften.
Add the soaked and drained rice to the pot, stirring gently to coat with the spices and vegetables.
Pour in 4 cups of water and add the bay leaf and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is cooked and the water is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let the biryani sit, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, and if using, top with yogurt and cashews before serving.

title: Coconut Ginger Chicken
description: A fragrant and creamy Thai-inspired dish featuring tender chicken simmered in a rich coconut ginger sauce, perfect for a satisfying dinner.

steps.instruction: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips.
Peel and grate the ginger. Mince the garlic cloves.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pan. Sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken strips to the pan. Cook until they are no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, lime juice, fish sauce, and coconut sugar. Stir well to combine.
If using, finely slice the red chili and add to the pan. Season with sea salt and black pepper.
Let the mixture simmer for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving, if desired.

title: Savory Tomato and Basil Galette
description: A rustic French galette filled with juicy tomatoes, fresh basil, and creamy feta cheese, encased in a flaky pastry crust.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, combine all-purpose flour and sea salt. Add unsalted butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add ice water, one tablespoon at a time, mixing until the dough comes together. Form into a disk, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice tomatoes into thin rounds and set aside.
On a floured surface, roll out the dough into a 12-inch circle. Transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Crumble feta cheese evenly over the dough, leaving a 2-inch border. Layer tomato slices over the cheese.
Sprinkle fresh basil, black pepper, and drizzle olive oil over the tomatoes.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pleating as you go. Beat the egg and brush the dough edges with the egg wash.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the tomatoes are tender.
Allow the galette to cool slightly before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Avocado Toast with Radishes and Dill
description: A simple and delicious breakfast option featuring creamy avocado on toasted bread, topped with crisp radishes and fresh dill for a refreshing start to your day.

steps.instruction: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
While the bread is toasting, cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocado with a fork until smooth. Add lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper to taste and mix well.
Slice the radishes thinly and set aside.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the toasted bread slices.
Top with sliced radishes and sprinkle with fresh dill. Drizzle with olive oil if desired.

title: Saffron Risotto with Peas
description: A creamy Italian risotto delicately flavored with saffron and enriched with sweet frozen peas for a delightful dinner.

steps.instruction: Finely chop the onion.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the arborio rice to the pan and stir for 2 minutes until the rice is well-coated with oil and slightly toasted.
Stir in the saffron and a ladle of vegetable broth, stirring constantly until the liquid is absorbed.
Continue adding the vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas and cook for another 3 minutes until they are heated through.
Remove the pan from heat and stir in the parmesan cheese, butter, sea salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving, if desired.

title: Creamy Mushroom Stroganoff
description: A rich and creamy Italian-inspired mushroom stroganoff, perfect for a cozy dinner.

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped garlic and sliced onion to the skillet. Sauté for 3 minutes or until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are browned and tender.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring it to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes to reduce slightly.
Stir in the sour cream, Dijon mustard, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and creamy. Reduce heat to low and let it simmer for another 5 minutes.
While the sauce is simmering, cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked pasta with the mushroom sauce in the skillet. Toss well to coat the pasta with the sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving, if desired.

title: Spicy Black Bean Quesadillas
description: A delicious Mexican-inspired lunch option featuring spicy black beans and melted cheese, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the black beans thoroughly.
In a medium bowl, combine black beans, cumin, cayenne pepper, and sea salt. Mash the beans slightly with a fork to mix the spices.
Chop the bell pepper into small cubes.
In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped bell pepper and sauté for 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add the black bean mixture to the pan and stir to combine with the bell peppers. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Preheat a clean pan over medium heat. Place one tortilla in the pan, and sprinkle half of the cheese evenly over it.
Spread half of the black bean and pepper mixture over the cheese, then top with another tortilla.
Cook the quesadilla for about 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is golden brown. Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make the second quesadilla.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Garnish with chopped cilantro and a drizzle of lime juice if desired before slicing into wedges.

title: Teriyaki Tofu Bowls
description: A delightful Japanese-inspired dish featuring crispy tofu, vibrant vegetables, and a savory teriyaki sauce served over fluffy rice.

steps.instruction: Press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, and minced garlic to make the teriyaki sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Remove tofu from the pan and set aside. In the same pan, add the remaining sesame oil and sauté chopped broccoli, sliced carrots, and sliced red bell pepper until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes.
Return tofu to the pan, add the teriyaki sauce, and stir well to coat. Cook for another 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
In a separate pot, cook the rice according to package instructions.
Dissolve corn starch in 2 tbsp of water and add to the pan with tofu and vegetables. Stir until the sauce is thickened.
Serve the tofu and vegetable mixture over cooked rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, if using.

title: Herbed Feta and Spinach Quiche
description: A delightful French-inspired quiche featuring creamy feta cheese, fresh spinach, and aromatic herbs, perfect for a brunch or an impressive dinner party appetizer.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add spinach and sauté until wilted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until well combined.
Crumble the feta cheese into the egg mixture. Add the sautéed spinach, basil, sea salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Place the pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish. Pour the egg and spinach mixture into the pie crust, spreading evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven until the quiche is set and lightly golden on top, about 30 minutes.
Allow the quiche to cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Cilantro Lime Shrimp Tacos
description: These Cilantro Lime Shrimp Tacos are a fresh and zesty Mexican-inspired dish perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

steps.instruction: Peel and devein the shrimp if necessary. Rinse under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine olive oil, lime juice, minced garlic, chopped cilantro, cumin, sea salt, and black pepper. Add the shrimp and toss to coat evenly. Let marinate for 10 minutes.
While the shrimp is marinating, thinly slice the cabbage and set aside.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until pink and opaque.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave. Keep them warm and pliable.
Assemble the tacos: Place a few shrimp on each tortilla, top with sliced cabbage, optional avocado slices, a dollop of sour cream, and a drizzle of jalapeno hot sauce if desired.

title: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
description: A comforting and healthy Mediterranean soup made with roasted red peppers and tomatoes, perfect for a light lunch.

steps.instruction: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the red bell peppers in half, remove the seeds and stems, and place them cut side down on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the peppers with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the skins are charred and blistered.
While the peppers are roasting, dice the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
In a large pot, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, sauté until the onion becomes translucent, about 5 minutes.
Remove the roasted peppers from the oven, let them cool slightly, then peel off and discard the skin.
Add the roasted peppers, canned tomatoes (with juice), vegetable stock, sea salt, and black pepper to the pot with onions and garlic. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from heat and add the fresh basil leaves. Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth. Alternatively, transfer the soup in batches to a blender and puree until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve hot, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.

title: Vegetable Fried Quinoa
description: A healthy and quick Chinese-inspired dinner featuring protein-rich quinoa and a medley of colorful vegetables, all tossed in savory soy sauce.

steps.instruction: Rinse the quinoa under cold water to remove any bitterness.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the quinoa, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy.
While the quinoa is cooking, mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and ginger, and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables to the skillet and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until they are tender-crisp.
Add the cooked quinoa to the skillet with the vegetables. Stir well to combine.
Pour the soy sauce over the quinoa and vegetable mixture, and stir to coat evenly.
Season with black pepper and sea salt to taste. Optionally, add sliced green onions and sesame seeds for garnish.
Serve hot and enjoy your Vegetable Fried Quinoa.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crispy and delicious sweet potato fries baked to perfection with a hint of paprika. A healthy and easy snack option.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash and peel the sweet potatoes. Cut them into evenly sized fries about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato fries with olive oil, paprika, sea salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the fries in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet, making sure they are not overcrowded.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the fries are golden brown and crispy.
Remove from oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy your healthy snack!

title: Coconut Mango Chia Pudding
description: A refreshing and tropical dessert made with creamy coconut milk, fresh mango, and nutrient-rich chia seeds.

steps.instruction: In a medium bowl, combine coconut milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Stir well to ensure the chia seeds are evenly distributed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a lid and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until the pudding thickens and the chia seeds have absorbed the liquid.
Before serving, stir the pudding to break up any clumps. Divide the pudding into two serving bowls or glasses.
Top each serving with fresh mango chunks. Serve immediately or keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Pasta Primavera
description: A colorful and fresh Italian pasta dish featuring an array of vibrant vegetables tossed with a light olive oil dressing.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

While the pasta is cooking, prepare the vegetables. Slice the bell pepper into thin strips, cut the zucchini into half-moons, and chop the broccoli into bite-sized florets. Peel and slice the carrots into thin rounds.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the prepared bell pepper, zucchini, broccoli, and carrots to the skillet. Season with sea salt and black pepper. Sauté the vegetables until they are tender-crisp, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the vegetables. Toss everything together to combine and heat through.
Serve hot, garnished with grated Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
